standard-dialogue-members.npc: Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes, or perhaps I could combine the charges on yer teleport jewellery.

steps.player: What's a pirate doing here?

steps.npc: By my sea-blistered skin, I could ask the same of you!

steps.player: But... I'm not a pirate?

steps.npc: No? Then what's that smell? The smell o' someone spent too long at sea without a bath!

steps.player: I think that's probably you.

steps.npc: Har har har! We've got a stern landlubber 'ere! Well, let me tell ye, I'm here for the Grand Exchange! Gonna cash in me loot!

steps.player: Don't you just want to sell it in a shop or trade it to someone specific?

steps.npc: By my wave-battered bones! Not when I can sell to the whole world from this very spot!

steps.text: If Lunar Diplomacy has been completed:

steps.player: You pirates are nothing but trouble! Why, once I travelled to Lunar Isle with a bunch of your type, and spent days sailing around in circles!

steps.npc: Then ye must know me brother! Murky Pat!

steps.player: Hmmm. Not so sure I remember him.

steps.npc: Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some [guy/gal] like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.

steps.player: Yes! That was me!

steps.npc: Ye sure be a different character.

steps.text: If the player has no jewellery that can be combined:

steps.npc: Arrr, ye've got nothing that I can combine.

steps.text: Unknown exact condition, possible if the player has only one piece of dragonstone jewellery:

steps.npc: Arrr, ye've nothing I can combine. Maybe ye needs to take yer stuff up to the Wilderness and charge it on the Fountain of Rune. It be more powerful than me.

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.npc: Arrr, I think ye be a bit short of inventory space.

steps.text: If the player has enough inventory space and jewellery to be decanted:
All jewellery in the inventory is decanted.

steps.npc: Arr, all done.

options.text: I hear you deal in rings of forging?

steps.player: I hear you deal in rings of forging?

steps.text: If the player does not have any ruby rings if their inventory:

steps.npc: Arrrr, bring me yer ruby rings to enchant.

steps.text: If the player has ruby rings, but less than 250 coins:

steps.npc: Arrrr, but they arrre 250gp per ring.

steps.text: If the player has ruby rings and at least 250 coins:

steps.npc: Arrr, 250gp per ring. How many would ye like me to enchant?
Arrr, be seeing ya.

of ruby rings and # of rings {{X}} 250 coins

steps.npc: Arrr, pleasure doin' business with ya.

know there is much more to a pirate than meets the eye.

steps.player: Aye-aye, captain!
Oh, come on! Lighten up!
